setup.zh: 洛水边，月亮升起来了。水上只有一个月影。水底卧着一口鼎，鼎口围着八个空位，排成一圈——你掌心的八口鼎一口一口亮了起来。圈的中间，空着。
setup.en: By the Luo the moon comes up. On the water there is only one reflection. At the bottom lies a cauldron, and round its mouth are eight empty places in a ring — one by one the eight cauldrons in your palm light up. The middle of the ring is empty.

recap.zh: 洛水底的鼎口围着八个位子，你掌心的八鼎一一亮起；圈的中间空着。
recap.en: At the bottom of the Luo eight places ringed the cauldron's mouth, and the eight cauldrons in your palm lit one by one; the middle of the ring was empty.

text.zh: 洛水……她就是在这里捡到我的。那天晚上，水上的月亮也只有一个。
text.en: The Luo… this is where she found me. That night, too, there was only one moon on the water.

alone.zh: 洛出书——大龟从这里背出了洛书。也有人说，很多年前，有人在这里的水上捡到过一个婴儿。
alone.en: The Luo gave up the writing — the great turtle brought the Luo square out of here. Some say, too, that long ago someone found a baby on this water.

label.en: Read the seal · Fill the centre

exits.means: reads the seal, names what belongs at the centre of the eight

text.zh: 你说出它的名字。圈的中间亮了起来。八口鼎从你掌心浮起，围着洛水里那一口，排成了九宫。
text.en: You say its name. The centre of the ring lights up. The eight cauldrons rise from your palm and ring the one in the Luo, making the nine palaces.

exits.means: reaches into the empty centre, tries to take the cauldron by force

text.zh: 圈的中间是空的。你伸手进去，什么也摸不到。
text.en: The centre of the ring is empty. You reach in and touch nothing.
